item.title: Keycloak-operator: keycloak-operator: secret-derived hashes exposed in statefulset metadata and keycloakoidcclient status
item.description: A flaw was found in the Keycloak Operator. Deterministic hashes derived from Kubernetes Secrets are published in generated StatefulSet metadata and in KeycloakOIDCClient status. A user with read access to those resources may be able to recover a low-entropy credential referenced by a Secret, even when Kubernetes RBAC denies the user access to the Secret itself.

item.title: Plane: Unauthenticated Asset Access via Presigned S3 URL in Upload Avatar Feature
item.description: Plane is an open-source project management tool. In versions prior to 1.4.0, the v2 asset static endpoint allows unauthenticated requests and returns presigned S3 URLs for an asset with access-signed parameters. Any user who knows an asset UUID can retrieve the signed URL without an account, providing access to that asset. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.0.

A remote client that sends an empty query string or request body to an application parsing it with this module can crash…

item.title: Gstreamer1-plugins-good: gstreamer: integer overflow in avidemux superindex/subindex parsing leading to out-of-bounds read
item.description: A flaw was found in GStreamer gst-plugins-good (avidemux). In the superindex and subindex parsers, integer overflow can bypass bounds checks and cause out-of-bounds reads. Because avidemux is auto-plugged by playbin, decodebin, and gst-discoverer, opening or previewing a crafted AVI is sufficient to trigger the issue. Fixed upstream in gst-plugins-good 1.28.6 (GStreamer-SA-2026-0072).
